Blushing Peach Cocktail
By: Helen Pitlick
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




3 cups raspberry juice, chilled
3 cups peach nectar, chilled
Peach slices and fresh raspberries for, for garnis

Preparation

1 In large pitcher, mix juices. Pour into glasses over ice. Garnish each glass with peach slice and raspberry if desired.

About


The striking color of this drink hints at its deep flavor.
